meta.title: Auth Cookie Sentinel
meta.description: Desktop launches pick a random port, and the Host's dsh-auth cookie is named after that port. Cookies ignore ports, so every launch accumulated another one until the 16 KiB header limit returned 431 and the welcome screen reported a Web authentication failure. This bundle raises the Host header limit to 128 KiB and prunes the stale cookies on the launch-token response.
